attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Moving sanitize_html/supported_cultures filter registration out of feature-gated startups into core Liquid services makes them globally available regardless of whether OrchardCore.Html/Localization features are enabled, which could cause DI resolution failures at runtime if their underlying services aren't registered for tenants without those features enabled."}

reason: Moving sanitize_html/supported_cultures filter registration out of feature-gated startups into core Liquid services makes them globally available regardless of whether OrchardCore.Html/Localization features are enabled, which could cause DI resolution failures at runtime if their underlying services aren't registered for tenants without those features enabled.
